places.name: Alexandra Palace
places.description: A Victorian entertainment venue on a hilltop park, site of the BBC's first TV broadcasts in 1936.

history.summary: N2 lies within Haringey. Formed in 1965 from Hornsey, Tottenham, and Wood Green. Alexandra Palace hosted the BBC's first regular high-definition television broadcasts in 1936.
